title: Western Blot Analysis and Immunoprecipitation Assay
author: Marzia Ognibene
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgecjtaw
materials: Protein content is evaluated by bicinchoninic acid assay (BCA Protein assay kit by Thermo Fisher) in a spectrophotometer.
Proteins are visualized by enhanced chemiluminescence (ECL) detection, through the Bio-Rad ChemiDoc instrument. Signal intensity was measured by densitometry using the Bio-Rad Image Lab 6.0 software.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Lysates for Western Blot
steps.instruction: Wash cells in cold PBS and lyse on ice using a specific lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Use lysis buffer containing 1.6 mM NaH2PO4, 8.6 mM Na2HPO4, 1% Triton X-100, 0.1% SDS, 0.1% NaCl, 0.5% NaDoc, 2 mM AEBSF, and 20 mg/mL each of aprotinin and leupeptin.

steps.title: Clarify Lysates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell lysates in a microfuge at maximum speed for 10 min to remove debris.

steps.title: Perform SDS-PAGE and Transfer
steps.instruction: Subject 100 µg of each lysate to SDS-PAGE electrophoresis and transfer the proteins to a PVDF membrane.

steps.title: Prepare Lysates for Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in a specialized immunoprecipitation buffer.

substeps.instruction: Use buffer containing 20 mM Tris-HCl, 1% Triton X-100, 10% Glycerol, 2 mM AEBSF, and 20 mg/mL each of aprotinin and leupeptin.

steps.title: Incubate Lysates with Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate 1000 µg of lysates overnight at 4˚C with the desired antibody under constant rotation.

steps.title: Capture Protein Complexes
steps.instruction: Add Gammabind G-Sepharose to the samples and rotate for 1 hour and 30 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µl of Gammabind G-Sepharose to each sample.

steps.title: Wash Immunoprecipitated Samples
steps.instruction: Wash samples three times using the lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge in a microfuge at 4300 g for 1 min per wash.

steps.title: Elute and Transfer IP Samples
steps.instruction: Elute samples and process for electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Elute samples in 40 µl of 1x Laemmli’s buffer.
Subject samples to SDS-PAGE and transfer to a PVDF membrane.

steps.title: Block PVDF Membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate the PVDF membrane in blocking buffer for 2 hr at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Use blocking buffer consisting of 4% nonfat milk in T-TBS (Tris Buffer Solution 1x with 0.05% Tween).

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane in primary antibody overnight at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Dilute primary antibody in 0.5% BSA in T-TBS.

steps.title: Wash Membrane After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane in T-TBS 5 times for 5 min each.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane in HRP-conjugated secondary antibody for 2 hr at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Dilute secondary antibody in 0.5% BSA in T-TBS.

steps.title: Final Membrane Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane in T-TBS 5 times for 5 min each.
